title: Gerwin Sturm: 8×8 signed grid precreasing
instruction: Complete ONLY the 8×8 grid example on source page 1. The supplied sheet already holds the first centre fold of the first panel; open it and continue. Include the shown turnover, all remaining creases in both directions, and finish with the sheet unfolded. Do not continue the later odd-division examples or fold the Porcupine. The first sheet face corresponds to the grey face in the diagram.
